note.title: Natural selection and evolution
note.overview: Populations evolve across generations when inherited variants differ in survival and reproduction and allele frequencies change.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for natural selection and evolution.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: Inherited variation -> competition -> better-adapted variants survive -> reproduce more -> pass alleles -> alleles become more common.
Individuals do not evolve during their lifetime.
Evidence includes fossils, anatomy, DNA/proteins, observed selection and geographical distribution.
